title: Suitcase ranking
description: In-stock Amazon suitcases ranked by size class. Carry-ons must fit the tightest of the four biggest U.S. airlines; large checked bags must stay within 62 linear inches.

airlines.note: The four largest U.S. airlines by passengers: American, Delta, United, and Southwest. Carry-on bags must satisfy every carrier. Large checked bags must stay at or under 62 linear inches.

policies.carryOn: 22 × 14 × 9 in including handles and wheels (45 linear in)

carryOn.label: Carry-on
carryOn.rule: Exterior including wheels and handles must be ≤ 22 × 14 × 9 in so the bag fits American, Delta, United, and Southwest. Expansion that breaks that box is noted.

small.label: Small check-in
small.rule: Overall height about 23–25.9 in. Too big for the four-airline carry-on box, smaller than a typical week-plus medium.

medium.label: Medium check-in
medium.rule: Overall height about 26–27.5 in including wheels and handles.

large.label: Large check-in
large.rule: Overall height about 27.6–31 in, and height + width + depth ≤ 62 in including wheels and handles. Many 28–30 in bestsellers fail this and were excluded.

suitcases.name: Briggs & Riley Baseline Essential 22" Carry-On Spinner
suitcases.why: Lifetime warranty and ballistic nylon make this the only carry-on here built like a tool, not a consumable.
suitcases.bestFor: Frequent flyers who will actually use the warranty.

suitcases.name: Kono 20-Inch Expandable PC+ABS Carry-On
suitcases.why: A verified 22×14×9 spinner with a 5-year warranty, 42 L, and a large review sample.
suitcases.bestFor: Anyone who wants a true sizer-fit hard shell without paying Briggs money.

suitcases.name: BAGSMART 20-Inch PC Expandable Carry-On
suitcases.why: A polycarbonate shell at the exact airline box, with useful expansion if you are not boarding AA, Delta, or United that day.
suitcases.bestFor: Budget travelers who still want a PC shell and a clean 22×14×9 spec.

suitcases.name: LUGGEX L2 Ex-Core 20-Inch Expandable Carry-On
suitcases.why: Amazon states the overall size including wheels and handle, and warns that the expanded bag may fail a sizer.
suitcases.bestFor: People who want a reviewed PC carry-on and will leave the expander unzipped at the gate.

suitcases.name: Kono 20-Inch Expandable Hardshell Carry-On
suitcases.why: The lightest verified sizer-fit spinner in the set, with a 5-year warranty. Expansion is for checked use.
suitcases.bestFor: Anyone who wants the lowest empty weight that still fits all four airlines.

suitcases.name: American Tourister Stratum XLT Expandable Carry-On
suitcases.why: A widely reviewed Samsonite-family ABS spinner with an explicit overall 22×14×9 measurement.
suitcases.bestFor: A known brand name at a sale price, if you accept ABS instead of PC.

suitcases.name: MILADA 20-Inch PC Carry-On
suitcases.why: Published 21.4 × 13.4 × 8.9 including wheels, so it sits inside the sizer with a little margin.
suitcases.bestFor: A PC carry-on when you want clearance, not a bag that kisses 22 × 14 × 9.

suitcases.name: LOVEVOOK 20-Inch Softside Carry-On with Laptop Pocket
suitcases.why: A stated 50 L softside at the exact 22×14×9 box, with a front laptop pocket and two cubes.
suitcases.bestFor: Carry-on packers who want fabric, a laptop sleeve, and cubes in the box.

suitcases.name: Varyleap 20-Inch Zipperless PC Carry-On
suitcases.why: Zipperless aluminum-frame PC with a published 21.3 × 13.8 × 8.6 overall size. Thin review sample.
suitcases.bestFor: People who want a frame-and-latch carry-on that still fits the four-airline box.

suitcases.name: Coolife 20-Inch Airline-Approved Carry-On
suitcases.why: One of the few bags whose item dimensions sit inside the box with room to spare, and it does not expand past the sizer.
suitcases.bestFor: Travelers who want a no-expander, no-argument fit on regional jets.

suitcases.name: LIGHT FLIGHT 20-Inch Expandable ABS Carry-On
suitcases.why: This SKU states 22 × 14 × 9 unexpanded. Other LIGHT FLIGHT listings on Amazon run wide or deep and were excluded.
suitcases.bestFor: A cheap expandable ABS spinner if you leave the expander closed at the gate.

suitcases.name: TRAVELARIM 20-Inch Expandable Carry-On
suitcases.why: A widely reviewed 22 × 14 × 9 spinner that includes a cosmetic case. Leave the expander closed for AA, Delta, and United.
suitcases.bestFor: Shoppers who want a large review sample at a mid-budget price.

suitcases.name: Hanke 20-Inch PC Carry-On
suitcases.why: A real PC shell with published overall size inside the box, at a higher empty weight than the cheap ABS clones.
suitcases.bestFor: Travelers who want Hanke's PC carry-on and will accept 8.1 lb.

suitcases.name: TagerTrek 20-Inch Softside Carry-On with Packing Cubes
suitcases.why: Softside flexibility plus included cubes, at a stated 22×14×9 overall size.
suitcases.bestFor: Packers who prefer fabric and want cubes in the box.

suitcases.name: Hulsin 20-Inch ABS Carry-On
suitcases.why: A no-expander ABS clone with an explicit 22 × 14 × 9 including wheels and handle.
suitcases.bestFor: A disposable-price hard shell when you do not want an expander zipper.

suitcases.name: Rockland Melbourne 20-Inch Hardside Carry-On
suitcases.why: The cheapest bag with a huge review sample and a stated 22×13.5×9 overall size.
suitcases.bestFor: A disposable-price spinner for rare trips.

suitcases.name: LOVEVOOK 24-Inch Softside Checked Spinner
suitcases.why: Unusually high 65 L capacity at 7.7 lb for a true small checked size.
suitcases.bestFor: A long weekend that still needs to be checked.

suitcases.name: Coolife 24-Inch PC+ABS Checked Spinner
suitcases.why: A light hard shell with a real review base, sitting just under the medium cutoff.
suitcases.bestFor: The default cheap small checked bag.

suitcases.name: Kono 24-Inch Polypropylene Checked Spinner
suitcases.why: PP at 7.5 lb and 59 L, sitting on the 25.9-inch small-class ceiling.
suitcases.bestFor: A light hard-shell weekend-to-week bag that still has to be checked.

suitcases.name: Kono 24-Inch Softside Expandable Checked Spinner
suitcases.why: Light, 65 L, and a stated 5-year defects period, with a thinner review sample than Coolife.
suitcases.bestFor: Softside packers who want expansion on a small checked bag.

suitcases.name: Traveler's Choice Archer 26-Inch Expandable PC
suitcases.why: Labeled 26-inch; item height is 25.5 in, which keeps it in the small class with an unusually high 77 L.
suitcases.bestFor: Maximum volume in a bag that is still under 26 inches tall.

suitcases.name: Delsey Paris Christine 24-Inch Expandable Spinner
suitcases.why: A glossy PC 24-inch that stays under 26 inches overall. Thin review sample.
suitcases.bestFor: A dressier small checked bag when volume is secondary.

suitcases.name: Kenneth Cole REACTION Flying Axis 24-Inch Hardside
suitcases.why: The cheapest verified small checked bag. The 3.9 rating is the floor for this list.
suitcases.bestFor: A first checked bag you do not mind replacing.

suitcases.name: Traveler's Choice Edinburgh II 25-Inch Hardside
suitcases.why: Sold as a 25-inch medium; overall height is 25.25 in, so it stays in the small class with 62 L.
suitcases.bestFor: A compact hard shell when you want more volume than a 24-inch ABS case.

suitcases.name: Amazon Basics 23-Inch Softside Checked Spinner
suitcases.why: Light to roll, but 42 L is a poor return on a 26-inch-class exterior.
suitcases.bestFor: Softside buyers who care more about empty weight than volume.

suitcases.name: Pathfinder 24-Inch Softside Expandable Spinner
suitcases.why: Overall 25.5 × 16.2 × 11.7 including wheels. Only 16 reviews, so the rating is noisy.
suitcases.bestFor: Softside buyers who want a true small checked size, not a 27-inch '24-inch'.

suitcases.name: Amazon Basics 24-Inch Hardside Checked Spinner
suitcases.why: Useful 63 L, but heavy for a small checked bag.
suitcases.bestFor: Capacity first, weight second.

suitcases.name: Travelpro Maxlite 5 Softside 25-Inch Spinner
suitcases.why: 7.3 lb and 95 L is the best weight-to-volume trade in the medium class, with a huge review sample.
suitcases.bestFor: Most people who will check a bag for one to two weeks.

suitcases.name: Briggs & Riley Baseline 26-Inch Medium Expandable Spinner
suitcases.why: The expansion and lifetime repair program are the product. You pay for not replacing it.
suitcases.bestFor: Professionals who check the same bag for a decade.

suitcases.name: Samsonite Freeform 24-Inch Medium Spinner
suitcases.why: Flexible PP that survives conveyor belts better than cheap ABS, with a 10-year warranty and 19k reviews.
suitcases.bestFor: A hard-shell medium that is still light enough to lift into a trunk.

suitcases.name: Travelpro Maxlite Air V2 25-Inch Hardside
suitcases.why: The 25-inch Maxlite Air sits at 27.5 × 18.5 × 12 including wheels — the medium ceiling and exactly 62 linear inches.
suitcases.bestFor: A Travelpro hard-shell medium if you will not expand past a tight 62-inch check.

suitcases.name: Samsonite Omni PC 24-Inch Medium Checked
suitcases.why: The older Omni PC 24-inch, with a 10-year warranty and a huge review sample. Distinct from Omni 2.
suitcases.bestFor: A known Samsonite PC medium that is still light enough to lift.

suitcases.name: Hanke 24-Inch Expandable PC Medium
suitcases.why: 66 L expanding to 76 L at 26.5 inches overall, well under 62 linear inches.
suitcases.bestFor: A week-plus PC case that is not as wide as Samsonite Freeform.

suitcases.name: Hanke 24-Inch Softside Medium with Garment Compartment
suitcases.why: Overall size including wheels is published, with a garment compartment and 66–78 L of expansion.
suitcases.bestFor: Softside packers who want a hanging compartment in a medium bag.

suitcases.name: Coolife Medium Hardside Checked Spinner
suitcases.why: Light and cheap, with dimensions that include wheels. 60 L is modest for a medium.
suitcases.bestFor: A low-price medium hard shell when you will not pack to the gills.

suitcases.name: American Tourister Stratum XLT 24-Inch Medium
suitcases.why: Sold as a 24-inch; overall height is 27 in. Light and cheap, with a large review sample.
suitcases.bestFor: A known-name ABS medium at a sale price.

suitcases.name: Delsey Paris Helium Aero 24-Inch Medium
suitcases.why: A long-running Delsey PC medium at the 27.5-inch class ceiling, with a 10-year warranty.
suitcases.bestFor: Shoppers who want a known Delsey hard shell and will accept 10.2 lb.

suitcases.name: Samsonite Omni 2 24-Inch Medium Checked
suitcases.why: A slimmer 26.5-inch overall PC case with a strong rating, sold as a 24-inch medium.
suitcases.bestFor: Travelers who want Samsonite PC without Freeform's wider footprint.

suitcases.name: Traveler's Choice Pagosa 27-Inch Medium Hardshell
suitcases.why: Light PP at a fair price, but 61 L is modest for a 27-inch exterior.
suitcases.bestFor: A light hard shell when volume is not the priority.

suitcases.name: Samsonite Octiv Medium Hardside
suitcases.why: A newer Samsonite PC medium at 27 × 17.25 × 11.5. Heavier and pricier than Omni PC.
suitcases.bestFor: Samsonite buyers who want the current Octiv shell instead of Omni.

suitcases.name: Away The Medium 26-Inch Checked
suitcases.why: Clean PC and good wheels, sold at a brand premium the warranty page does not justify.
suitcases.bestFor: People who already like Away's interior layout.

suitcases.name: Kenneth Cole REACTION Out of Bounds 24-Inch Hardside
suitcases.why: Overall 26 × 18.5 × 10.25 at $67, with a huge review sample and a limited lifetime warranty.
suitcases.bestFor: A cheap, widely reviewed medium when brand cachet is not the point.

suitcases.name: SwissGear 7272 Energie 24-Inch Hardside
suitcases.why: A true 26-inch overall hardside. The 4.1 rating and thinner review sample keep it mid-pack.
suitcases.bestFor: A SwissGear hard shell when you do not want the oversized 7366.

suitcases.name: Amazon Basics 26-Inch Hardside Medium Checked
suitcases.why: The most-reviewed medium on Amazon. ABS, 63 L, and a price that matches the construction.
suitcases.bestFor: A first suitcase you do not mind replacing.

suitcases.name: Travelpro Platinum Elite 25-Inch Softside Spinner
suitcases.why: Sold as a 25-inch medium; overall size with wheels and handles is 28 inches, so it is a large bag that still sits well under 62 linear inches.
suitcases.bestFor: Frequent checkers who want Travelpro's best softside without going to a 29-inch oversized shell.

suitcases.name: Travelpro Maxlite Air V2 28-Inch Hardside
suitcases.why: 140 L at exactly 62 linear inches. Leave the expander closed if a carrier is measuring tightly.
suitcases.bestFor: Long trips that still have to clear a 62-inch sizer.

suitcases.name: Briggs & Riley Baseline 29-Inch Large Expandable Spinner
suitcases.why: 122 L and a lifetime repair program at 61 linear inches unexpanded. Expansion goes to 63.5.
suitcases.bestFor: Professionals who will check the same bag for a decade and leave the expander closed.

suitcases.name: Hanke 26-Inch Expandable PC Checked Spinner
suitcases.why: Labeled 26-inch; overall height is 27.9 in, which puts it in the large class with 93 L and a comfortable 57.2 linear inches.
suitcases.bestFor: A large-capacity PC case that is not skating the 62-inch line.

suitcases.name: Delsey Paris Cruise 3.0 26-Inch Trunk
suitcases.why: A trunk shape at 60 linear inches including handles and wheels, with a 5-year warranty.
suitcases.bestFor: Packers who want a wide trunk that is cheaper than Chatelet Air.

suitcases.name: Delsey Paris Chatelet Air 2.0 26-Inch Trunk
suitcases.why: A trunk shape that stays under 60 linear inches, with a 10-year warranty.
suitcases.bestFor: Packers who like a wide, shallow trunk instead of a tall spinner.

suitcases.name: Travelpro Platinum Elite Hardside 28-Inch
suitcases.why: Airline-friendly 61.5 linear inches and a lifetime program, dinged by a 4.0 rating and 12.3 lb empty weight.
suitcases.bestFor: Travelpro buyers who want a hard shell instead of the Elite softside.

suitcases.name: Kono 28-Inch Expandable Hardside Large
suitcases.why: 108 L at 59.8 linear inches with a 5-year warranty. The listed 4.7 lb empty weight is treated as unverified.
suitcases.bestFor: A high-volume hard shell that stays clear of the 62-inch line.

suitcases.name: Away The Large 29-Inch Checked
suitcases.why: Hits 62 linear inches exactly. There is no measurement margin if a carrier is strict.
suitcases.bestFor: Away owners matching a carry-on, who will not expand the bag.

suitcases.name: LEVEL8 Luminous 28-Inch Trunk
suitcases.why: 99 L in a trunk that stays under 60 linear inches. The 4.0 rating is the weak point.
suitcases.bestFor: Maximum volume in a trunk that still clears 62 linear inches.

suitcases.name: SwissGear Sion Softside Large Expandable Spinner
suitcases.why: A 10-year warranty and 7,700 reviews at 61 linear inches. Volume claims on the page conflict (80 L vs 114 L); 80 L is used.
suitcases.bestFor: A softside large bag with warranty coverage and a sane price.

suitcases.name: Kono 28-Inch Softside Large Checked
suitcases.why: A 28-inch-class softside that stays at 59 linear inches, with room under the 62-inch cap.
suitcases.bestFor: A budget fabric large bag that will not fail a linear-inch stick.

suitcases.name: Away The Large Softside 29-Inch Checked
suitcases.why: Away's fabric large bag hits 62 linear inches exactly. Expansion can push it over.
suitcases.bestFor: Away owners who want fabric instead of the hardside Large.

suitcases.name: Amazon Basics 28-Inch Softside Large Checked
suitcases.why: Very light for a large bag, but 62 L wastes the exterior size. The 30-inch Amazon Basics hardside was excluded at 64 linear inches.
suitcases.bestFor: Keeping empty weight down when you will not fill a 100 L case.

excludedNotes: Travelpro Platinum Elite 21-inch carry-on measures 23.5 × 14.5 × 9 in overall and fails American, Delta, and United sizers.

Away The Carry-On is 14.4 in wide. Samsonite Freeform carry-on is 15.25 × 10 in. Amazon Basics 21-inch is 14.8 × 10 in. LEVEL8 Grace, July, Delsey Helium/Chatelet carry-ons, and several LIGHT FLIGHT SKUs also exceed 22 × 14 × 9.

Amazon Basics 30-inch hardside is 64 linear inches. Samsonite Omni PC 28, Winfield 2 28 (31 × 20 × 12.75), Element 28, Delsey Cruise 28, and most American Tourister 28-inch shells exceed 62 linear inches.
SwissGear 7366 27-inch overall size is 30.75 × 20.5 × 12.25 in (63.5 linear inches). Travelpro Maxlite 5 29-inch is 65 linear inches.
Color variants of the same model are listed once. Luggage sets, underseat personal items, two-wheel bags, and out-of-stock pages were excluded. Monos 22 × 14 × 9 pages were out of stock.
